body.name: Canonical switching-certificate bound \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\)
body.construction:
Let \(m=|\mathcal A|\), \(L=|\mathrm{LIT}|\), \(n=|V|\), and \(M=|\Omega|\).  Define
\[
 B_{\mathrm{sw}}
 =M\left(m+L+M+n(1+L)
 +8(n+1)^2\left\lceil\log_2(n+L+M+2)\right\rceil\right).
\]
This is the canonical singleton-branch switching-certificate length bound.  It is finite but need not be polynomial in the structural input.
